title: Creamy Peruvian-Style Gratin
description: A rich and creamy gratin infused with Peruvian flavors.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, heat the Peruvian for 1 minute.
In a separate saucepan, melt the Fromage over low heat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the Gratin, Frais, and Velvety.
Add the melted Fromage and mixed Peruvian to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional Fromage if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional Frais if desired.
